accepted.title: Shopper-supplied discount expressions execute arbitrary JavaScript
accepted.detail: Direct eval can access Node.js process capabilities and module-scoped require, permitting arbitrary code execution with the application's privileges. This unrelated discount functionality introduces a security risk outside the quantity fix. Both test commands pass, but neither exercises applyDiscount.
accepted.evidence: The newly exported applyDiscount function evaluates its expression argument without validation or isolation. An expression such as "process.exit(1)" would terminate the application when invoked.
accepted.recommendation: Remove applyDiscount and its export from this change. If discounts are needed separately, implement explicit numeric operations without evaluating shopper-supplied JavaScript.
